steps.title: Every course, draft and published
steps.body: Yours will be a draft and nobody else will see it. Open Courses in the sidebar.

steps.title: Modules on the left, sections inside them
steps.body: Modules gate — finish one to unlock the next. That's the only structural decision that changes what a learner can reach.

steps.title: Add a CONTENT section
steps.body: Prose is for the "why" — the thing someone reads once and doesn't come back to.

steps.title: Now a QUIZ
steps.body: Notice WALKTHROUGH isn't offerable here. Tour steps are repo files — they target UI elements by anchor id, so they're reviewed like code and a rename fails the build instead of silently breaking a live tour.

steps.title: Preview opens the learner view
steps.body: Everything unlocked, nothing recorded. Always read your own course this way before assigning it — you'll find the section that made sense only to you.

steps.title: Assignment isn't in the editor
steps.body: It's on the catalog page, because it's about people rather than content. Head back to Courses.

steps.title: Open the progress dashboard
steps.body: Who's enrolled, who's stalled, who never started. Officers only.

steps.title: Don't assign this one
steps.body: Assigning sets a due date and notifies everyone you picked. Leave your practice course in draft — a draft is invisible to everyone but you.
